systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: News/Media claim global oil supply and pricing remain stable.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: The $2.52 Brent-WTI spread proves that high-risk seaborne crude carries an active war/transit insurance premium over pipeline crude, while depleted SPR (282,184 k bbl) limits emergency supply intervention.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: News/Media claim the US Dollar is soft or neutral based on superficial 6-currency DXY.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: The Fed's 26-nation trade-weighted Broad Dollar (122.65) and positive SOFR spread (5.00 bps) verify that global supply chain chokepoints are actively creating an acute offshore dollar funding crunch across Emerging Markets.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: News/Media claim trade sanctions and BIS export controls have cleanly severed advanced hardware transfer to China.
